method: All embedded images in HTML exhibits with no substantive extracted text in the EDGAR filing inventory. Image bytes were retrieved by the same accession and filename, retained with hashes, and transcribed using Apple Vision English text recognition. Selected OCR phrases serve only as leads: primary-text source and date verification govern labels. Empty readings remain visible. Only pages matching the filing inventory were screened.
